sources.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies
sources.what: official name, description, grade and PSN count where tracked

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow the roadmap stages in order and it pops at the end of stage 6, with 100% completion.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission, Gone Fishing, is the first thing the story asks of you — play through it and the trophy pops at its end. Nothing here can be missed; it is the front door to the game.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission to its end card.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1's missions in order. Chapter trophies are unmissable — finishing the chapter is all it takes, so take your time and enjoy the story.
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2's missions in order. Like every chapter trophy, it cannot be missed — the chapter's end is the trigger.
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 2.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3's missions in order. The trophy is the chapter's end card — unmissable, and a good moment to check the missables list before the story moves on.
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 3.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4's missions in order. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale — finish any open stranger strands first if you are close to their final missions.
steps: Play every mission of Chapter 4.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission — the gold trophy for seeing the game through to its end. It cannot be missed: complete the mission and it is yours. After the credits, free roam opens for the cleanup stages.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 and start the final mission.
Complete the final mission to its end card.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the story mission Breakfast Run — finish it during the mission itself; if the moment passes, replay the mission before moving on.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies pop at the mission's end, so play the mission through rather than rushing past its objectives.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run unlocks.
Complete Breakfast Run to its end card.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the story mission The Cartel Heist — finish it during the mission itself; if the moment passes, replay the mission before moving on.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set pieces: follow the plan the mission lays out, and the trophy pops when the crew gets away.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist unlocks.
Complete the heist to its end card.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the story mission Child's Play — finish it during the mission itself; if the moment passes, replay the mission before moving on.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it pops at the mission's end — just play the mission through.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play unlocks.
Complete Child's Play to its end card.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the story mission Headliners — finish it during the mission itself; if the moment passes, replay the mission before moving on.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission through to its end card and the trophy pops with it.
steps: Play the story until Headliners unlocks.
Complete Headliners to its end card.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the story mission VCIA Takedown — finish it during the mission itself; if the moment passes, replay the mission before moving on.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Takedown missions reward a clean run: follow the mission's plan and finish it to the end card.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown unlocks.
Complete VCIA Takedown to its end card.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the story mission Operation Savage Glory — finish it during the mission itself; if the moment passes, replay the mission before moving on.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named-mission trophies — play it through to the end card.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory unlocks.
Complete the mission to its end card.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the game's own checklist of story, strands, activities and collectibles, all finished. It is the last gold before the platinum and it cannot be missed, only left for last: work the roadmap stages in order and this pops when the final item is ticked.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Complete all activities, collectibles and challenges the completion counter tracks.
Check the in-game completion percentage and sweep up whatever is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the total, and it builds up naturally across the whole game. Chase it deliberately in free roam: string stunts together on open roads and ramps rather than grinding one spot.
steps: Play normally — stunts accumulate as you drive.
In free roam, chain jumps, drifts and near misses to push the count up.
The trophy pops at stunt 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one taste of everything Leonida offers, from the range to the races. It is a sampler, not a grind: open each activity, play one round, and move on.
steps: Find each activity type on the map and play one round of it.
Repeat for all 9 types — the trophy pops on the ninth.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the hardest skill trophy in the list. Take one weapon class at a time, learn each challenge's rhythm, and replay any challenge until gold lands; silver or bronze on a challenge means one more try, not a failure.
steps: Open the Shooting Range activity.
Work through the 42 challenges, one weapon class at a time.
Replay any challenge below gold until it medals gold — the trophy pops on the 42nd gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone racing is about clean lines, not speed alone: learn each course's turns, cut the corners the course allows, and win one race per location — the count is locations, not races.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races on the map.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations.
The trophy pops on the 14th location win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list across Leonida, pick the vehicle class you drive best, and tick each new event off once.
steps: Open the race list and pick an event you have not won.
Win it, then move to the next new event.
The trophy pops on the 20th different win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head on the water, not a solo catch count. Fish the challenge the way the game teaches it (steady reeling, no slack when the fish runs) and outscore Cal.
steps: Take the fishing challenge against Cal.
Outscore him on the catch — steady reeling beats yanking.
The trophy pops when Cal loses.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any cabinet, one full playthrough to its end. The easiest trophy on the list: walk up to an arcade machine, play, and finish the game.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one arcade game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the final mission of Andy's strand — once the strand ends, its missions are gone except through mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands unlock across the map as the story moves — follow Andy's strand to its last mission and finish it.
steps: Find Andy's strand missions and play them in order.
Complete Andy's final mission to its end card.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the final mission of Kenton's strand — once the strand ends, its missions are gone except through mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Play Kenton's missions in order until the strand's last mission appears, then finish it.
steps: Find Kenton's strand missions and play them in order.
Complete Kenton's final mission to its end card.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the final mission of Billy's strand — once the strand ends, its missions are gone except through mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Follow Billy's missions to the strand's end and finish the last one.
steps: Find Billy's strand missions and play them in order.
Complete Billy's final mission to its end card.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the silver for doing the stranger circuit properly. Strands appear as the story opens up the map; finish eight of them end to end, including Andy's, Kenton's, Billy's, Randy's and Tyrone's.
steps: Play stranger strands as they appear on the map.
Finish each strand's missions to its end.
The trophy pops on the 8th completed strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the final mission of Randy's strand — once the strand ends, its missions are gone except through mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Play Randy's missions in order until the strand's last mission appears, then finish it.
steps: Find Randy's strand missions and play them in order.
Complete Randy's final mission to its end card.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableWhy: Tied to the final mission of Tyrone's strand — once the strand ends, its missions are gone except through mission replay.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Follow Tyrone's missions to the strand's end and finish the last one.
steps: Find Tyrone's strand missions and play them in order.
Complete Tyrone's final mission to its end card.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — a calm collectible that doubles as a tour of the map's quiet corners. Each spot is one meditation; visit them all and the trophy pops on the 18th.
steps: Find the meditation spots across Leonida.
Meditate at each one.
The trophy pops on the 18th spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a stranger strand with a single, specific quarry. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, track the animal the strand points to, and take it cleanly.
steps: Play Bret's strand until the hunt is offered.
Track the unique animal and hunt it.
The trophy pops when the hunt is done.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — cards hidden across Leonida, a set at a time. Collect the cards of a set and it completes; finish three sets for the silver. Work one set at a time and keep a note of which cards you still need.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida.
Complete one full card set.
Repeat until 3 sets are complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — the game's photo-spot collectible, spread across the whole state. It is a long, pleasant grind: tick spots off as you travel for other trophies and the count climbs on its own.
steps: Use WAiNK It at a location to log it.
Keep logging new locations as you travel.
The trophy pops at location 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's rolling list of small feats, from driving to combat to exploration. They complete as you play; check the challenge list now and then and pick off the ones nearest done.
steps: Open the challenge list.
Play toward the challenges nearest completion.
The trophy pops on the 50th completed challenge.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableWhy: Needs your partner beside you at 4 stars wanted — partners are only around for parts of the story, so do it while you have one.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape together. Do it while a partner is available in the story — then pick a quiet stretch of road or water, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear.
steps: Play with your partner beside you.
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and stay hidden with your partner until the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableWhy: Needs your partner beside you for three robberies in a row — same partner window as Hot Together; do it while you have one.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan the route first — three shops close together, a fast getaway car, and no police attention between robberies — then run them in one chain.
steps: Pick three shops close together and a getaway car.
Rob the first shop with your partner.
Rob the second and third back-to-back without losing your wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride anything new and it counts. The count climbs fastest when you try variety: cars, bikes, boats and anything with wheels you have not driven yet.
steps: Drive any vehicle you have not driven before.
Try new vehicle types as you find them.
The trophy pops at vehicle 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-time aiming mode. Set it up where enemies group together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends; a busy firefight is a better stage than a quiet one.
steps: Find a fight with enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableWhy: A one-off departure at VCIA — the chance comes once in the story flow; take it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport by a way the airport did not schedule. When the chance appears in the story flow, take it: get to a plane or a runway exit and leave on your own terms.
steps: Reach VCIA when the chance appears.
Make your departure by an unscheduled route.
The trophy pops once you are away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks — and survive the heat they bring. This one is deliberately vague in the official description: expect a wanted-level fight with military hardware, and keep moving so a Rhino's cannon never gets a clean shot.
steps: Draw military attention until Rhinos arrive.
Survive the encounter with the tanks.
The trophy pops when the moment is survived — the description gives no count, so treat it as one event.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean, quiet job. Case the store first, go in when the floor is clear, take the goods without tripping an alarm or a witness, and leave before anyone notices.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its floor.
Enter and take the goods without being seen.
Leave undetected — the trophy pops on a clean getaway.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time — the silver for the full vault circuit. Plan each job with a getaway car ready, hit the vault, and get clear before the response arrives; five clean escapes earn the silver.
steps: Find a bank vault and plan a getaway.
Rob the vault and escape.
Repeat for 5 vaults — the trophy pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — a classic GTA job, straight from the series' playbook. Stop the truck, take its cargo, and lose the wanted level before the trophy pops.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it and take its cargo.
Escape clean — the trophy pops on the getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the full map, every district and backwater. Drive the whole state systematically, area by area, and the trophy pops when the last one registers. It pairs well with the WAiNK and vehicle hunts.
steps: Drive through every area of Leonida.
Check the map for areas you have not visited.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are explored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one hit per gang across Leonida. Learn which operation belongs to which gang, hit one of each, and the trophy pops on the ninth gang's operation.
steps: Find an illegal operation and note its gang.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for all 9 gangs — the trophy pops on the ninth.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — the game's quietest trophy and a good first one. Walk the Ocean Beach front, find a bar with a view, order a cocktail and take in the water.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar with a view of the water.
Order and enjoy a cocktail.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass, GTA style. Pick a showroom, get a fast car inside or at the door, and leave through the front window.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Get a car moving at speed inside or at the entrance.
Smash out through the showroom front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a game there, a nod to the series' most famous pastime. Walk in, play a full game, and the trophy pops at the follow-through.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling through to its end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableWhy: A story partnership moment — it happens once, in the story's flow; play the partnership scenes as they come.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a story moment between the two leads that the description keeps deliberately vague. Play the partnership scenes as they come in the story; the trophy pops at the moment itself, so do not skip the scenes.
steps: Play the story's partnership scenes as they appear.
The trophy pops at the moment — it cannot be forced in free roam.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableWhy: Choices made in the story cannot be unmade in that playthrough — think before you pick, and note which choice you made.
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one, so it is about making decisions across the game, not a single pick. Keep playing, keep choosing when the game asks, and the count climbs; the trophy pops when the count is met.
steps: Keep playing and make choices when the game offers them.
Watch the PSN count climb toward 500.
The trophy pops when the count is met.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed on a second try where the first one failed. The description is deliberately vague, so treat it as a retry trophy: fail an attempt at something, then succeed on the very next try.
steps: Attempt something and fail it.
Succeed on the immediate second try.
The trophy pops on the second-try success.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the game's strange-event trophy, the kind GTA hides in odd corners of the map. Explore the weird places, follow anything that looks out of place, and the trophy pops when you witness the event.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and landmarks.
Follow anything strange you find.
The trophy pops when the event happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass beside a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops when they go down like a pin.
steps: Get in a vehicle and find a pedestrian.
Make a slow pass and strike with a melee attack.
The trophy pops when the target is bowled over.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the game's dirty-money loop. Marked Bills come from the heists and robberies; launder them through your contacts a little at a time and the total climbs to $250,000.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, food, weapons, anything with a price tag. It counts across every shop in the game, so just buy what you need as you play and top up with big purchases late in the game.
steps: Buy gear, clothes and supplies as you play.
Spend across different shops.
The trophy pops at $100,000 total spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — a home for every ride you collect. Garages go on sale as you progress; buy each one when it appears and the trophy pops on the eighth purchase.
steps: Find garage properties for sale.
Buy each one as it appears.
The trophy pops on the 8th garage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — snap or log ten different rides into the app. Variety helps: register a spread of cars and bikes you find around Leonida, and the trophy pops on the tenth.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle to it.
Repeat for 10 vehicles — the trophy pops on the tenth.
